notes.title: Pre-Alpha 4.1.0
notes.content:
- added death screen
- fixed some small bugs that were reported in PA4.0.0
- added post processing
- added labels to HUD
- added restart game to pause menu

notes.title: Patch Windows issue v0.2
notes.content: This is simply a rebuild of what I pushed this morning just in case something didn't build properly. It looks like there is a difference in the manifest so please try to test it again after it updates.

notes.title: Demo Updates
notes.content:
- Fixed issues players were having with vegetation spawning on top of the camera
- Severely upgraded the performance from ~30 fps to over 100 fps on test machine builds
- Added Main menu screen when pressing Tab
- updated Inventory to open when pressing Tab or the "I" key
- Added prototype crafting station
- Added some animals throughout the starter area
- Added swamp area
